name: Assessing AI Opportunities
outcome: Assess potential AI use cases, limitations, risks and feasibility.
description: Assess the suitability of AI for a scientific problem or research group. Compare expected benefits, feasibility, data requirements, risks and the option of not using AI.
external: Familiarity with a research problem or workflow; no programming required.
learn: Identify candidate AI tasks and conventional alternatives
Assess feasibility, data requirements and risks
Define success criteria and decide whether SSC support is needed
moduleDescriptions: Define a research question, success criteria and current workflow.
Compare AI, conventional algorithms and manual methods against a baseline.
Assess data quality, resource needs, licensing, risk and cost.
Write a short go/no-go recommendation with evidence and limitations.
prerequisiteRationale: F01 provides AI/non-AI distinctions needed for a feasibility decision.
